blindUniqueId.title: Blind Unique ID
blindUniqueId.description: A unique identifier for this blind (will be used to generate the accessory UUID)

displayName.title: Display Name
displayName.description: The name that will be displayed in HomeKit

debug.title: Debug Mode
debug.description: Enable debug logging for this device

model.title: Model
model.description: The model name of your window blinds

manufacturer.title: Manufacturer
manufacturer.description: The manufacturer of your window blinds

serial.title: Serial Number
serial.description: The serial number of your window blinds

urlGetCurrentPosition.title: URL to Get Current Position
urlGetCurrentPosition.description: The URL to get the current position of the blinds

urlSetTargetPosition.title: URL to Set Target Position
urlSetTargetPosition.description: The URL to set the target position of the blinds (use %VALUE% as placeholder for the position value)

statusPattern.title: Status Pattern
statusPattern.description: Regular expression to extract position from HTTP response (default captures first number)

matchingGroup.title: Matching Group
matchingGroup.description: Which regex capture group to use for the position value (default: 1)

outputValueMultiplier.title: Output Value Multiplier
outputValueMultiplier.description: Multiplier for the position value sent to the device

minOpen.title: Minimum Open Position
minOpen.description: Minimum position value (usually 0 for fully closed)

maxOpen.title: Maximum Open Position
maxOpen.description: Maximum position value (usually 100 for fully open)
